title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version keeps the curated reader-facing working surface and adds the RA28 validated Greek-nu rebase package plus RA29, a source-critical Paper 02 body-audit tranche through printed pp.84-90.

Current reader files. The main cumulative readers and standalone English paper PDFs remain the reader-facing surface. RA25-RA29 are correction/audit tranches for the German/source branch of Paper 02, not full multilingual propagation packages.

Latest correction packages. Adds N_SYM_RA28_nu_validated_20260612.zip and N_SYM_RA29_P02_p84_90_20260612.zip. RA28 validates that the form letter in Paper 02 main invariant-system grammar is Greek \nu, not Latin v, while preserving genuine polar Latin v contexts. RA29 fixes source-critical issues in Section 25 printed pp.83-84 and Section 26 printed pp.85-90, including spatial displays, primes/hats, formula (32) hats, dot-products, annotations, references, and the missing printed p.90 331-form summary. Together these tranches close the Paper 02 body printed pp.23-90 at the current page-level standard; table plates remain open.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts, translation drafts, and source-audit correction packets; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Known open items. Paper 02 Table I and Table II plate-level audit remain open, followed by propagation to EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH. Full symbol-level source audit remains open beyond Paper 01 and the current Paper 02 tranches.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
